title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (North Carolina)
authority: North Carolina employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: North Carolina requires employers with 25 or more employees (not counting employees whose employment is under nine months a year) to use E-Verify for new hires.

appliesWhen.description: 25 or more employees in the state

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.
